title: Business Development Executive
company: St. Michael's Hospice (North Hampshire) - Agency - Permanent
description:
What are we looking for?

Are you a confident relationship-builder who can spot potential in a conversation and inspire businesses to support a local cause? We are looking for a creative and results-focused Business Development Executive who understands what motivates businesses and can build mutually beneficial partnerships. You will develop new business, build relationships with prospective partners and create tailored opportunities that generate income and wider support for St. Michael's Hospice, while helping existing corporate supporters deepen their involvement.

Key Responsibilities:
- Be an active and visible presence within the local business community, building new relationships through purposeful networking, meetings and consistent follow-up.
- Research and approach prospective corporate partners, identify shared opportunities and develop a strong pipeline of new business.
- Secure new income and support by presenting compelling ideas, making confident asks, negotiating effectively and following opportunities through to agreement.
- Develop fresh and creative partnership opportunities that go beyond traditional fundraising and offer genuine value to both the business and the Hospice.
- Grow existing corporate relationships by understanding each business's priorities and identifying opportunities to increase or broaden its support.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues across the Hospice to shape and deliver successful corporate partnerships.

What We're Looking For:
- Experience in business development, sales, recruitment, account management, corporate partnerships or fundraising. Charity-sector experience is welcome but not essential.
- A proactive and self-motivated approach, with the confidence to take ownership, initiate conversations and actively seek out new opportunities.
- A track record of building strong relationships and securing new business, partnerships or other tangible results.
- Confidence in networking, presenting, negotiating and making a clear ask, combined with the determination to follow opportunities through.
- A creative thinker who can spot potential, generate new ideas, make a persuasive case for them and take responsibility for turning them into action.
- Highly organised, with a consistent approach to follow-up and the ability to manage multiple relationships at different stages.
- A collaborative approach, a full driving licence, access to a car and flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends.

Why work with us?

You will join a supportive and ambitious fundraising team with an established network of corporate relationships and a clear corporate strategy to build upon. This is an outward-facing role with genuine scope to take ownership, introduce new ideas, test different approaches and influence the next stage of our corporate development.

We offer office or hybrid working with an expectation to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week and a location close to the hospice for ease of access. Plus, you'll love working in an environment where every day brings new challenges and rewards.

St. Michael's Hospice is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of vulnerable adults, children and young people. All staff are expected to share this commitment. Successful candidates will be required to undergo relevant background checks, including a DBS check and provide satisfactory reference before starting the role.

About St. Michael's Hospice

St. Michael's Hospice (North Hampshire) is a registered charity and provides support to people diagnosed with a life-limiting illness. It is a Hospice for adults providing invaluable palliative and end-of-life care services in North Hampshire, offering comfort, support, and dignity to those facing life's most challenging moments.

As a charity, we depend on the kindness and support of our local community to continue offering our services free of charge. It may come as a surprise, but only 22% of our funding comes from the government. End-of-life care is an essential service, not a luxury, yet it is not funded like other care services. To keep the Hospice's services running, we need raise an additional £15,000 every day.

Our benefits

We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits, including, free parking, life assurance, 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays, and an extensive health and wellbeing plan and company pension.

Interested?
For more information or an informal chat about the role, please contact the fundraising team.

How to Apply:
To be considered for this role, please submit the following:
- Cover letter explaining why you're an ideal candidate for this position. Please note that applications without this will not be considered.
- CV outlining your relevant experience and skills.

Closing date: Friday 25 September at 12 noon

Interview Date: Wednesday 30th September in person at Millennium House, Priestley Road, RG24 9 GZ

title: Sales Coordinator
description:
Sales Coordinator

Outskirts of Tadley, Hampshire

Full Time Permanent

Are you an organised, customer-focused professional who enjoys keeping everything running smoothly?

We're looking for a proactive Sales Coordinator to join a busy commercial team where you'll play a vital role in delivering an exceptional customer experience. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy building relationships and take pride in providing first-class service, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As Sales Coordinator, you'll be responsible for managing customer orders from receipt through to delivery, ensuring every stage of the process runs efficiently and customers remain informed throughout.

Working closely with customers, Area Sales Managers and internal departments, you'll become a key point of contact for order enquiries, pricing, stock availability and after-sales support.

No two days are the same, making this an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys variety, problem solving and delivering outstanding service.

What You'll Be Doing
- Processing customer orders accurately and efficiently
- Coordinating orders from confirmation through to delivery
- Keeping customers informed of order progress and delivery updates
- Responding to pricing, stock and product enquiries
- Resolving delivery, invoice and after-sales queries
- Raising credit notes where appropriate
- Building strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring administration is completed to a high standard
- Supporting the wider commercial team to deliver excellent customer service

About You

You'll be someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers and takes pride in delivering a professional service.

We're looking for someone with:
- Previous experience in customer service, sales support, order processing or administration
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Great attention to detail and accuracy
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Excel
- Experience using ERP or CRM systems
- A proactive approach with excellent problem-solving abilities
- A driving license and car due to the location of the company

What We're Looking For

We're seeking someone who:
- Enjoys working as part of a collaborative team
- Is customer-focused and commercially aware
- Takes ownership of their workload
- Remains calm under pressure
- Can adapt to changing priorities
- Thinks ahead and looks for solutions before problems arise

What's On Offer
- Permanent, full-time opportunity
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Ongoing training and development
- The opportunity to join a well-established, growing business where your contribution is genuinely valued

If you're an organised and customer-focused professional looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of a team committed to delivering outstanding service every day.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Account Manager / Client Manager
description:
Account Manager / Client Manager - Financial Services

Salary: £30,000 - £45,000 ( Dependant on Experience)

Location: Fleet

Job Summary

To manage a portfolio of high-net-worth insurance clients, providing exceptional customer service The role is responsible for ensuring clients' insurance requirements are met, managing day-to-day enquiries, maintaining strong client relationships, and supporting the wider team in delivering a professional broking service.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and maintain a portfolio of high-net-worth insurance clients.

Maintain accurate client records and ensure all information is updated within internal systems.

Process new business accounts, ensuring policies are accurately placed and documentation is issued within agreed timescales.

Manage client renewals, including reviewing cover, remarketing policies where required, and issuing renewal documentation in line with FCA requirements.

Handle client queries, policy amendments, and mid-term adjustments relating to cover changes.

Work collaboratively with Client Managers and colleagues to deliver excellent client service and support account management activities.

Assist with preparation of client reports and supporting documentation.

Identify opportunities to enhance client relationships through appropriate cross-selling and up-selling of products and services.

Contribute towards team revenue objectives through strong client retention and new business support.

Requirements

Previous experience within insurance, account management, client services, or a similar customer-focused role.

Knowledge or understanding of household insurance products.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Ability to work independently, take ownership, and contribute positively as part of a team.

Professional, proactive, and customer-focused approach.

Commitment to delivering excellent client outcomes and maintaining regulatory standards.

Desirable

Cert CII qualification or willingness to work towards completion.

Experience working with high-net-worth clients or within a professional services environment.

Experience using insurance systems, CRM platforms, or client databases.

Understanding of FCA regulations and insurance compliance requirements.

Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience.

Opportunities for professional development and ongoing training.

Support towards insurance qualifications and CPD.

Collaborative and supportive working environment.

Company benefits package.

Opportunity to build strong relationships with valued clients and work within a specialist insurance team.

title: Ad Agency Customer Success
description:
Role: Ad Agency Customer Success

Company: CV Library

Location: Fleet, Hampshire

Work Patten: Hybrid

Hours: Mon - Fri, 9.00am - 5.30pm

Salary: Competitive salary

CV Library, one of the UK's leading job sites, is seeking an Ad Agency Customer Success Manager to join our growing team. As an Ad Agency Customer Success Manager, you will play a vital role in ensuring the success and satisfaction of our advertising agency clients.

In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with our advertising agency clients, understanding their needs, and delivering outstanding customer service. You will work closely with our sales and operations teams to manage the onboarding process, monitor campaign performance, and identify opportunities for account growth.

Responsibilities:
- Build and maintain strong relationships with assigned advertising agency clients
- Act as the main point of contact for clients, providing exceptional customer service
- Understand client goals and objectives and develop strategies to help them achieve success
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth campaign implementation and execution
- Monitor campaign performance and provide regular updates and insights to clients
- Identify opportunities for account growth and drive upsell and cross-sell initiatives

Requirements
- Prior experience in a customer success or account management role, ideally within the advertising or digital marketing industry
- Strong relationship building and communication skills
- Ability to understand client needs and deliver tailored solutions
- Exceptional customer service and problem-solving abilities
- Analytical mindset with the ability to generate insights from campaign performance data
- Experience working with advertising platforms, such as Google Ads or Facebook Ads, is preferred

Benefits
- Excellent basic salary with generous bonus scheme
- 23 days annual leave, plus additional days for length of service and your birthday!
- Regular team incentives and social events including our amazing High Flyers trips.
- Discounts with major cinemas and retailers, family days out, and much more
- Life Insurance and Company Pension
- Employee Assistance Programme (Mental Health & Well-being support)
- Great culture and work environment

We are actively committed to promoting a fully diverse and inclusive workforce and we welcome applications for this role from all candidates who meet the key requirements. Please do not hesitate to get in touch should you require any reasonable adjustments to assist with your application.

Due to the regular onsite requirement for this role, it would be most suitable for UK based candidates. All applicants must already hold the Right to Work in the UK.
